payload.subject: Derived-State Integrity
payload.name: Derived-State Integrity
payload.purpose: Eliminate the class of defects in which SYNTH's own read paths dirty the working tree, block expedition completion, or leave governance state uncommitted - by classifying every artifact once (durable, input, derived, cache, legacy) and enforcing two invariants: reads never write, and derived state never blocks work.
